summary.description: Authorized fields only. Product-review rows always include audit_id and product_id.

counts_by_kind.description: Counts all four kinds for the authorized ownership and keyword filters before applying the selected kind.

can_lift.description: Management viewpoint only. True when this enforcement is applied, not already lifted, and reversible by API-CASE-008.

reported_message.description: Exact reported message identity without body or sender, only for the assigned manager.

target.description: Exact reported comment or evaluation projected only for the assigned manager.

pending_appeals.description: Only the assigned manager receives unresolved appeals. Each item names the active applied original enforcements that affected the appellant; use one with the original thread when submitting manager_reply. Reversal, lifted and terminal records are omitted.

original_enforcements.description: Eligible original executions tied to this appeal account: active applied trade freeze, account restriction or display withdrawal. Never includes a previous lift, a replacement record, a terminal adjustment or irreversible content removal.

original_enforcement_id.description: Required for revoke or adjust: the manager-selected original execution from pending_appeals[].original_enforcements. Omit for statement, appeal and uphold.

replacement_enforcements.description: Only valid for adjust. Requires a concrete action on the same target as the selected original execution; omit for revoke, uphold, statement and appeal.

expected_result.description: For adjust_trade_status: completed, terminated, or in_progress. in_progress restores only an abnormal trade and keeps its occupancy and freezes.
